stocks.label: Ledger
stocks.subject: Reddit: the history follows you between phones on the Reddit Google Sheet. You › History, the posts read (what Unread only leaves out) and the searches go to the sheet's History, Read and Searches tabs and come back from them, merged three ways (reddit/public/hist.js), so what one phone opened, cleared or marked unread reaches the others; something taken off on one phone but opened again on another since stays. Sent a few seconds after a change, at start, when the app comes back to the front and when the internet is back; with no internet it stays on the phone and goes later. Set up under You › Google Sheets with the setup QR (new app `reddit` in adblock/lib/setup.mjs and Control's QR list) or a pasted phone-setup.json. The sheet's requests go out through Warranty's Http bridge (net.js), Reddit's own still through MainActivity; the APK gets the camera for the QR. Asked: "save reddit history to a google sheet so it saves between devices". Tests: hist.test.mjs (9, three mutants each red), page.mjs G checks (25) against a stand-in Google that refuses writes past a tab's grid (taking out the grid sizing = 2 red); javacheck 11 unit tests; Ad Block 26. page.mjs's V check (the list's picture copy) was already NOT OK before this change.

translate.label: Translate
translate.subject: Translate: a Dictionary tab, the user's own words to read, hear and practise. A third icon at the foot (book) opens Words | Practice: Words lists 31 words in four groups (Feelings, People and family, Talking, Money and work), each with its Thai, its reading and its meaning, and a tap says it; Practice is Learn's quiz over them (English to Thai, Thai to English, hear it), a miss coming back a few questions later, and half the time the wrong answers come from the word's own group. The words were written as heard ("kang bon", "tak chai", "ka dued rong"); the Thai is กังวล, ทำใจ, ความเดือดร้อน and so on, and every reading is the app's own word list's (LearnTest). A swipe right from Words goes back to Learn. Asked: "add these Thai words to the Thai English translation app via a third option called dictionary let me practice them too". javacheck 37/37 (2 new tests); 3 mutants red (no same-group answers, Words swiping to Translate, a wrong reading).

nudge.label: Nudge
nudge.subject: Nudge: seven fixes from a review of the phone side. A task that came before notifications were allowed (Android 13+ starts with them off) was counted as nudged and never shown; now it rings as soon as they are allowed, also from Settings (the app nudges again on every return). Nudges are alarm clocks, so every 5 minutes holds while the phone dozes (the other kind is let through only every ~9 minutes). An answer from the Pi older than a tick just sent no longer brings the ticked task back. Done on a notification can no longer hold Android's receiver past its limit. A place allowed in Settings is watched at once. A second Save where I am is no longer cut short by the first one's timeout. A send that keeps failing waits longer each time, up to 2 minutes, instead of every 15 s for ever. Proof: compiles against android.jar, unit tests 13/13, the two-phone drive passes.
